participation.context: Wrote the list and did not count the pages.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the shirt and the cloak on the going side. You left the chronicle on the shelf and the pages of the wood under the board, unnumbered.

title: Listed the second shirt and grey cloak to go, chronicle and pages of the wood to stay

participation.context: Named first light, left the pages and the chronicle, and did not count.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Took the hour, repeated the empty chamber, and refused a second twenty shillings.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Said the hour aloud and did not write it.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Not in the room. Named again as forbidden the lord's book.
participation.name: Gib

relations.note: the hour is said, not written

story.body: You named first light and stopped. She kept the promises she made yesterday, and she refused a second payment of the quarter. Alse held the hour in her ear.

relations.note: the hour is said, not written

title: Told Mistress Ansell the hour is first light
